title: Restricted Without Ticket

request.justification: Need to review encryption key metadata for security audit

expected.explanation: ABAC rule restricted-requires-ticket denies access to restricted data without a valid ticket ID

teachingPoint: Restricted data always requires a ticket — even privileged roles must follow the process

title: Restricted With Ticket

request.justification: Security audit of encryption key rotation compliance

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role allows S3 read in prod with restricted classification, and the ticket ID satisfies the ABAC rule

teachingPoint: A valid ticket ID unlocks restricted data access — this is the audit trail that makes sensitive access accountable

title: Intern Confidential Data

request.justification: Need to read API configuration for onboarding project

expected.explanation: ABAC rule confidential-no-intern denies Interns access to confidential data

teachingPoint: Data classification restrictions can override role permissions — interns are limited to internal data only

title: Auditor Restricted No Ticket

request.justification: Reviewing PCI compliance data for annual certification

expected.explanation: ABAC rule restricted-requires-ticket blocks restricted data access without a ticket ID, even for Auditors

teachingPoint: Even auditors need tickets for restricted data — the rule applies universally

title: Auditor Restricted With Ticket

expected.explanation: Auditor role permits S3 read in prod with restricted classification, and ticket ID satisfies ABAC rule

teachingPoint: With a ticket, auditors can access restricted data — the process exists to create accountability

title: Developer Restricted Dev Data

request.justification: Need to read secrets for local integration testing

expected.explanation: Developer role maxClassification for S3 in dev is confidential, not restricted

teachingPoint: Even in dev, restricted data is off-limits for Developers — classification ceilings are per-role

title: Cross-Team RDS Describe

request.justification: Checking payments team DB status for cross-team dependency

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped requires team match; core cannot describe payments team RDS instances

teachingPoint: Team scoping applies to all resource types — even read-only describe actions are team-restricted for Developers

title: Intern Restricted Dev Access

expected.explanation: ABAC rule confidential-no-intern denies Interns access to restricted data (restricted is higher than confidential)

teachingPoint: Restricted is even more sensitive than confidential — interns are blocked from both by ABAC

title: Security GuardDuty With Ticket

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role permits GuardDuty read in prod with restricted classification, ticket satisfies ABAC rule

teachingPoint: With a ticket, Security Engineers can access restricted GuardDuty findings — the process enables the investigation

title: Analyst Reads Restricted Prod

request.justification: Need PII data for customer segmentation analysis

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role maxClassification for S3 is confidential, not restricted — even with a ticket

teachingPoint: ABAC ticket rules only help if the role allows the classification level — Data Analysts cap at confidential
